captions.text: Can a joke use AI to put words / in a leader's mouth? / Two courts, [two answers].
captions.plain: Can a joke use AI to put words in a leader's mouth? Two courts, two answers.

captions.text: Berlin, 2024: a court banned / an AI video of the chancellor: / not clearly [satire].
captions.plain: Berlin, 2024: a court banned an AI video of the chancellor: not clearly satire.

captions.text: California, 2024: a parody ad / gave a candidate an AI voice. / A new law demanded a [label].
captions.plain: California, 2024: a parody ad gave a candidate an AI voice. A new law demanded a label.

captions.text: A judge struck the law down: / answer a joke with more speech, / not a [ban].
captions.plain: A judge struck the law down: answer a joke with more speech, not a ban.

captions.text: EU law since August: an AI fake / must be labelled. Satire too, / just [lightly].
captions.plain: EU law since August: an AI fake must be labelled. Satire too, just lightly.
